messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning SDK v13 rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: cutover hosted + dedicated clients, phased canary, no breaking changes. Need smoke owners, rollback ready, and a short client comms blurb. :rocket:
maria: I can own the hosted smoke checks. I'll run the post-deploy sanity and perf probes.
sam: I'll take rollback (oncall) and watch logs. Keep me pinged if canary>5% or error rate >1.5%.
jen: I'll update the SDK changelog + migration notes and prepare a one-paragraph comms for customers.
natalie: I'll coordinate Dedicated capacity owners — ETA to confirm node pools is EOD.
deploy-bot: CI: all pipelines passed for release/v13 - commit abc1234. Artifacts uploaded.
alex: Thanks. Proposed canary plan:
- 0-10m: 1% traffic
- 10-30m: 5% traffic
- 30-60m: 20% traffic
- 60m+: 100% if no regressions
Use the rollout flag: --canary=percentage
maria: For smoke checklist I'll run:
1) basic generate call with max_tokens=128
2) chat streaming scenario
3) embeddings vector length
4) verify perf under 95th latency baseline
I'll paste results here.
sam: Rollback checklist:
- Freeze traffic routing
- kubectl rollout undo deploy/sdk-api -n prod
- Revert client-facing flag in gateway config
- Notify customers
jen: Comms blurb draft:
"SDK v13 is rolling out on DATE. No breaking changes expected. Update recommended for minor feature X. See release notes: <link>"
alex: Good. Add a note about pinning versions for Dedicated customers.
natalie: Dedicated note: need 6GB extra per pool for quantized models — ops confirmed.
maria: smoke step 1 results: generate OK, sample token counts match. latency 90p ~ 180ms :thumbsup:
sam: watching logs now, raising pager if >1% 5xx in canary window.
jen: comms ready, will send to growth for customer broadcast once alex approves.
alex: approve. I'll kick the rollout at 09:00 PT. Ping @sam @maria at each phase and post updates here. :eyes:
maria: noted.
sam: ready.
deploy-bot: Rollout started at 1968123600 — canary 1% applied.
maria: canary 1% smoke OK.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 5% at 1968124200.
maria: canary 5% smoke OK, no errors.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 20% at 1968125400.
sam: seeing a transient spike in p50 CPU at 20% but error rate stable. continuing.
alex: continue to 100% at T+60 unless sam calls stop.
deploy-bot: Final scale to 100% at 1968127200. Rollout complete.
jen: pushed release notes and updated SDK page.
natalie: Dedicated pools scaled, no issues.
sam: no rollback needed, closing watch after 1h.
alex: great job everyone. I'll drop a short retro in #eng-releases later. :tada:
